interpretations: Compute each station’s average `bandusagepct` across its telescopes, excluding NULLs. Compare it with the average across all telescopes with non-NULL `bandusagepct`. Return the 10 stations with the largest positive difference, showing the station, its average, and the unrounded difference

Compute each station’s average `bandusagepct` across its telescopes, excluding NULLs. Compare it with the unweighted average of the station averages. Return the 10 stations with the largest positive difference, showing the station, its average, and the unrounded difference
queries:
WITH station_averages AS (
  SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS station_avg
  FROM telescopes
  WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY observstation
),
global_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) AS overall_avg
  FROM telescopes
  WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  s.observstation,
  s.station_avg,
  s.station_avg - g.overall_avg AS difference
FROM station_averages AS s
CROSS JOIN global_average AS g
WHERE s.station_avg > g.overall_avg
ORDER BY difference DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH station_averages AS (
  SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
)
SELECT
  observstation,
  avg_bandusagepct,
  avg_bandusagepct - (SELECT AVG(avg_bandusagepct) FROM station_averages) AS difference
FROM station_averages
WHERE avg_bandusagepct > (SELECT AVG(avg_bandusagepct) FROM station_averages)
ORDER BY difference DESC
LIMIT 10;
